what: The machine-readable half of the P1-28 closing package. It names ONE commit as the phase's code candidate and records every measurement taken against it, with the provenance of each. docs/phase-1/phase-1-28/evidence/closure-evidence.md is the prose half and must state the same candidate; scripts/ci/build-p1-28-evidence-manifest.mjs refuses a disagreement between the two.
why: P1-27 shipped a closing page that pinned a head 47 commits behind the tree it described, and it went on reading like evidence because nothing compared the claim with the repository. A closing value that names no head is not a measurement of anything. Every figure below therefore carries the head it was taken at and the artefact it came from.
whatThisIsNot: This is not a tamper-proof seal. The digests in evidence-manifest.json remove SILENT revision, not revision. It is ALSO not an Owner acceptance and not a closure record: the phase is OPEN and `OWNER ACCEPTANCE` has neither been asked for nor returned. What it now IS is a package whose current remediation half has been taken: nine bindings, including all five tiers, CodeQL, dependency security, browser-by-project and the database reproof, cite exact-head PR CI run 31885987461 at 1a186a7bcb7d0b97bb771753dacb584535692455. The unit and web figures agree with the authoritative local observation at ea045d88 pinned by ledger commit 2e0f2191. The earlier aggregate hostedCi and production-build records remain fetchable at product-identical 81cbd44b because the exact remediation run legitimately skipped those change-classified build jobs. Every cited head descends from the candidate, its apps/** and supabase/** are COMPUTED byte-identical to it, and each binding says so with `describesProductIdenticalSuccessor`. `pendingHostedBindings.bindings` is EMPTY by derivation. The two superseded citations this package has carried, 55b932cb and 38afa5c2, are kept in `supersededObservations`.

First, the drift apparatus exists for the case where a re-freeze is IMPOSSIBLE because a product path moved; using it when the front door is open weakens what it means when it is used. Third, nothing is lost: what this commit did and why is recorded here with the fidelity a successor entry would have carried. Neither choice made any known-bad world vacuous; that was checked before choosing, and is not why the choice was made.

candidate.vocabularyNote: `FINAL_CODE_SHA` and `FINAL_CODE_TREE` are the names this package was commissioned under and are used here so the commissioning brief and this record cannot drift apart. They are NOT the P1-27 spelling: that phase says `CODE_CANDIDATE_SHA` for the same idea, and no file in this repository used `FINAL_CODE_*` before this one. The mapping is recorded below rather than left for a reader to guess, because two names for one commit is exactly how a superseded head gets quoted as a current one.

vocabularyMapping.FINAL_CODE_SHA: P1-27 calls this CODE_CANDIDATE_SHA — the frozen product candidate. Later evidence-machinery commits are allowed only when named as successors and computed product-identical.
vocabularyMapping.FINAL_CODE_TREE: The tree object of that commit. P1-27 records no equivalent field; it is added here because a tree id is what makes two checkouts comparable without trusting a commit message.
vocabularyMapping.EVIDENCE_RECORD_SHA: P1-27's name for the commit carrying the evidence file — here, the documentation-only commit that carries this record, which the gate PRINTS rather than requires to be named because a commit cannot name itself.
vocabularyMapping.EXECUTABLE_DIFF_COUNT: P1-27's derivation `git diff --name-only CODE_CANDIDATE_SHA..EVIDENCE_RECORD_SHA` excluding docs/ and *.md. It is non-zero here because six executable paths differ from the product candidate: the ownership profile, the seal, the seal suite, two acceptance-fixture commands and their boundary suite. sealSuiteInvariant.whyItIsLoadBearing: The seal's own suite must be indifferent to which of the two states the package is in, because BOTH are ordinary and both recur. A package is PENDING on the head that first carries a new candidate, since no run has been taken at a descendant of it yet; it is BOUND on the head that records the run which measured it. Every cycle passes through both, in that order. A test that hard-codes either state makes the other unreachable — and that is what happened: this file asserted `hostedCiRecorded === false`, SEARCHED the committed package for a pending tier, and required `supersededBindings.length > 0`. Four cases were STRUCTURALLY UNSATISFIABLE the moment anything was bound, because no package can be both bound and pending. Binding and freezing had become MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE, and a phase whose seal cannot be bound and frozen at once can never close.
sealSuiteInvariant.howItWasNotNoticed: The suite was green and the gate was correct. A test that cannot pass in a state nobody has reached yet is indistinguishable from a test that passes. It surfaced only when the eleven bindings were bound for the first time and eight cases went red at once.
sealSuiteInvariant.whatWasNotDoneToFixIt: No rule was weakened. Each kept its strength and moved its subject: the tier rule DELEGATES its four conditions to `pendingBinding`, so the test cannot drift looser than the gate; both anti-vacuity guards are driven over a sound, genuinely empty scratch range and observed red; and the world flags are cross-checked against this document's own `pendingHostedBindings`, which `worldFrom` never reads. 82 self-check worlds run on every invocation (66 analyser-derived worlds plus 16 reporter cases) and `selfCheck` returns 0 failures.
